mapper.insert: INSERT INTO price_alerts (account_id, symbol, direction, target_price, status) VALUES (#{accountId}, #{symbol}, #{direction}, #{targetPrice}, 'ACTIVE')
mapper.select: SELECT id, account_id, symbol, direction, target_price, status, created_on, triggered_on, triggered_price FROM price_alerts WHERE account_id = #{accountId} ORDER BY created_on DESC, id

SELECT a.id, a.account_id, a.symbol, a.direction, a.target_price, a.status, a.created_on, a.triggered_on, a.triggered_price, s.last_observed_price FROM price_alerts a LEFT JOIN price_alert_state s ON s.alert_id = a.id WHERE a.symbol = #{symbol} AND a.status = 'ACTIVE' FOR UPDATE OF a
SELECT count(*) FROM price_alerts WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.update: UPDATE price_alerts SET status = 'CANCELLED' WHERE id = #{id} AND account_id = #{accountId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
